description: Independent synthetic contrast suite. Labels reflect owner requirements R2/R6/R13/R18 and the explicit universal thought-structure objective, not an answer key from existing development or real owner exports.

label_protocol.self_project: Direct relation to the named owner system, including evidenced continuation; conceptual analogy alone does not imply membership.
label_protocol.owner_philosophy: Owner commitment or materially relevant conceptual discussion; unrelated software topic does not suffice.
label_protocol.conceptual_structure: Useful material for argument/operation analysis, independent of project membership.
label_protocol.self_discovery: Includes direct system material and explicit owner commitments; generic conceptual questions remain ambiguous in this narrower task.
label_protocol.ambiguous: Abstain is preserved and counted, never relabeled to help a method.
label_protocol.split: Groups fixed before method results. Each comparison group remains wholly in one split; natural vocabulary differs across splits. Validation is synthetic and not a substitute for unopened owner holdout.
